{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check the updated values
print("Updated unique values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Verify that SEVERE disease patients exist
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']
print("Number of patients with SEVERE disease:", len(df_severe))

# Check for any remaining sentinel values
print("Remaining sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum())"}
